business.model: Home-based studio, direct-to-consumer personalised resin gifting
business.differentiation: Personalization and finish discipline, not catalogue size or lowest price

safety: Read and follow resin manufacturer instructions and SDS guidance
Wear nitrile gloves and a suitable respirator mask; ensure cross-ventilation
Restrict workspace access from children and pets
No food-contact or heat-use claims unless the full material-and-design system is verified
Store pigments, inks, and mixed resin away from living spaces

roadmap.title: Starter setup
roadmap.detail: Essential tools, safe workspace, restricted palette, multipurpose molds, sample testing

roadmap.title: MVP catalogue
roadmap.detail: Launch 10–12 items, consistent photography, cost every SKU, open direct sales

roadmap.title: Customization system
roadmap.detail: Proof approvals for names, photos, flowers, wedding details, sentimental pieces

roadmap.title: Controlled expansion
roadmap.detail: Grow toward 50 demand-validated products, bundles, premium editions, seasonal drops

roadmap.title: Business development
roadmap.detail: Selected wholesale, corporate gifting, repeat-customer programs, marketplace tests

roadmap.title: Scale with proof
roadmap.detail: SOPs, bulk buying, dedicated workstations, stronger QC, B2B capacity
